channel.title: Said & Checked: Utah — AskAmerica
channel.description: What officeholders said each day from or about Utah, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Utah, 2026-11-20: none false or contradicted, 4 unsettled (John Curtis, Mike Lee)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • John Curtis, U.S. Senator: “We are seeing platforms offer opportunities to wager on everything from sporting events to war and human tragedy.” Unsettled. AP and Al Jazeera reporting documents Kalshi and Polymarket contracts on sports and on U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran, but no page read documented contracts on disasters or deaths.
  • Mike Lee, U.S. Senator: “Estimates are that this will save every American family, just on electric power cost alone, many hundreds of dollars a year once we can get BAAJA passed into law.” Unsettled. Rhodium Group's November 2026 analysis estimates average household electricity bills falling $41 to $66 a year by 2035, or $196 to $334 cumulatively through 2035; no estimate of hundreds of dollars a year was found.
  • Mike Lee, U.S. Senator: “There is only one provision of this entire bill--only one--that even touched the Clean Air Act, and it was written by the Senator from Oregon.” Unsettled. The introduced text of S. 5653 has one Clean Air Act reference, in a list of applicable laws, with no indication of authorship; a C2ES summary describes a managers' amendment section amending the Clean Air Act for prescribed fires, which would be a second, but the Senate-passed text could not be read.

10 statements by 2 officeholders. 8 checked: 4 supported, 4 unsettled · 2 not checkable.
